challenges.title: Pipeline Completo
challenges.task: Pipeline: 1) remova cancelados, 2) preencha valor nulo com mediana, 3) converta data para datetime, 4) extraia dia da semana, 5) some valor por dia da semana
challenges.starter_code:
import pandas as pd
import io
data = """id,cliente,valor,data,status
1,Ana,250,2024-01-15,ok
2,Bruno,,2024-01-16,ok
3,Clara,320,2024-01-17,cancelado
4,Diego,90,2024-01-18,ok
5,Eva,410,2024-01-19,ok
6,Fabio,150,,ok"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))
# Complete o pipeline aqui
challenges.solution:
df = df[df['status'] == 'ok'].copy()
df['valor'] = df['valor'].fillna(df['valor'].median())
df['data'] = pd.to_datetime(df['data'])
df = df.dropna(subset=['data'])
df['dia_semana'] = df['data'].dt.day_name()
resultado = df.groupby('dia_semana')['valor'].sum()
print(resultado)
